summary: Iteration 5 validated end-to-end. Backend 13/13 pytest pass (7 new): POST /api/residents/merge reassigns capsules to keep_id + soft-deletes duplicates (verified via GET after merge), 400 on empty/self-only merge_ids, 404 on unknown/inactive keep_id; GET /api/residents/{id}/carnet returns 200 application/pdf with %PDF- header and Content-Disposition racontelle-carnet-<nom>.pdf (with capsules, empty, and 404 unknown). Frontend: workshop mode switch (workshop-mode-question/workshop-mode-free) visible when idle, hidden while recording/done; question mode shows question card + 'Question 1 sur 3' progress; free mode shows 'Souvenir libre' card; profile workshop defaults to free, switching to question + record/save works (advanced to Q2). Stats 'Profils en double' section appears for the 3 Jeannes; merge modal opens, merge-confirm disabled until merge-keep-<id> selected; after merge: notice shown, duplicates vanish from home + stats, and server-side the donor Jeanne's capsule was re-attached to the kept Jeanne. 'Imprimer le carnet (PDF)' opens a new tab issuing GET .../carnet -> 200 application/pdf + 'Carnet PDF prêt' notice. Regressions OK: export ZIP (GET .../export -> 200 application/zip, racontelle-claire.zip) + 2-step removal modal (confirm gated on export-done), stats counters, archive with capsules. ONE CRITICAL crash found and fixed: ArchiveScreen ReferenceError (busyCapsuleId is not defined) whenever archive contained >=1 capsule -> full error-boundary screen. Fixed by adding the 4 missing destructured props; archive now renders rows + play/transcribe/share buttons with zero console errors.

rca_of_issue: Bug: archive screen crashed with full error boundary whenever >=1 capsule existed. Reproduction: record any souvenir, open 'Mes souvenirs' -> 'Something went wrong / busyCapsuleId is not defined'. Root cause: ArchiveScreen (app/index.tsx:736) destructured only { styles, colors, insets, residents, capsules, selectedId, onSelect, onBack, onPlay } but its CapsuleRow JSX used busyCapsuleId, playingCapsuleId, onTranscribe, onShare (all passed by the parent at line 629). With an empty archive the CapsuleRow branch never rendered, which is why iteration 4 missed it. Fix: added the 4 missing props to the destructuring; verified archive renders capsule rows with play/transcribe/share and zero console errors.
